verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents a standing model-deprecations page with an advance-notice policy and migration guides. The models overview lists per-model retirement floors (e.g. "Not sooner than September 1, 2027"), and a dedicated model-ID versioning page explains pinned versus moving IDs, so developers can lock to a model and plan migrations. Missing for 10: the length of the notice period and the contents of the migration guides are not detailed in the pack, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration that notice was actually given before past retirements.
